systems: Reviewed attack path dnd5e only; broader combat/multiattack rollout stays paused.
minimum_reads: foundry_read_attack_state(scene_id, actor_id, request_id) when an attack is needed
steps: Read round, turn, order and defeated state; define whether boundary means end of current round or one traversal from current turn.
Choose only eligible NPC mechanics under explicit intent and system support; do not choose player actions.
Execute reviewed bounded steps, preserving each stable action ID and confirmed receipt; damage application never rerolls attack.
Stop for player turn, reactions, required choices, missing rules, partial or uncertain outcome.
After response/reconnect reread combat and receipts; confirmed actions are history, not instructions to replay. Reconcile changed initiative, new/defeated participants and combat ending.
Advance only a confirmed completed eligible turn and never beyond boundary. Report factual rolls/damage/effects and next actor.
evidence: Confirmed per-step receipts plus current combat order/round/turn; attempted actions never prove HP/resources changed.
round_trips: State reads plus movement/attack/application/effects/advance per eligible turn; resumable interactions can span model requests. No measured planning or latency claim.
gaps: Existing attack sequence presence does not authorize expanding paused rollout
